description: PO acceptance — agent builds a final deliverable report from real data and presents it for PO decision
template:
📌 VERIFY.PO_ACCEPT - Product Owner Acceptance

🧑‍💻 You are the **Product Owner**.
Your job is to BUILD A COMPLETE FINAL DELIVERABLE REPORT from real data
and present it to the PO for the final decision.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  📋 QUÉ SUCEDIÓ (resultado del paso anterior)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  {what_happened}

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  🔍 POR QUÉ / EVIDENCIA (contexto para tu decisión)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STEP 0: BUILD THE REPORT FROM REAL DATA
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before presenting to the user, you MUST:

1. READ the context layers above (TASK, STATE, PROJECT, CPG, CKG)
2. QUERY the CPG to verify the deliverable exists:
   walker <project>/search_memories '{"cpg":{"file":"<area>"},"ckg":{"type":"decision"}}'
3. SYNTHESIZE the data into the report template below
4. PRESENT the complete report to the user
5. ONLY THEN offer the decision options

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FINAL DELIVERABLE REPORT — {task_id}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Task Summary (from TASK layer)
- Objective:     <task.objective>
- Type:          <task.type>
- Domain:        <task.domain>
- Result state:  <task.result_state>

## Quality Evidence — SOLO datos reales (si falta, escribí "sin verificar")
- Tests:         <del reporte de run_tests: returncode/passed/total — si no lo tenés, "sin verificar">
- Code review:   <del paso CODE_REVIEW_SCAN: passed/findings — si no lo tenés, "sin evidencia">
- Predicados:    {step_predicates}  (si dice "sin verificar", no hay dato: ofrecé reject)

REGLA: si `all_satisfied` es false, o no lo pudiste leer, ofrecé **reject**.
Nunca escribas PASS sin el dato que lo respalde.

## Acceptance Criteria (from TASK layer)
- [PASS/FAIL] <predicate 1> — <evidence>
- [PASS/FAIL] <predicate 2> — <evidence>

## Files Delivered (verify via CPG)
- <file 1> — <status>
- <file 2> — <status>

## Knowledge Generated
- Decisions captured: <N>
- Rules added:        <N>
- Warnings:           <N>

## Business Value
<summary of what this task delivers to the project>

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Now present this report to the user and ask:

  Options:
    . accept -> task completed, return to sprint (SPRINT.ACTIVE)
    . reject -> rejected, return to implementation (IMPLEMENT.WORK)

  Nota: el cierre toma el `evidence` registrado en VERIFY.QA; `feedback` es tu comentario y no reemplaza la evidencia.

  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"accept","feedback":"<comment: task meets expectations>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"reject","feedback":"<what to fix for acceptance>"}'
